reviews.snippet:
Worst service ever.. one of the outpatient doctor general physician has given pottasium citrate raw solution 25ml to my father for galbladder stones and has injected gentamicin to reduce fever..which should not be given to a Kidney patient.. so I suggest better choose other hospital.. I have proofs of prescription which they have given to my father. Because of their act my father's creatine shoot up from 3.3 to 13+ in few hours.. and had to  admit immediately and cured but made a huge bill of more than 1 lakh.. They have done dialysis for seven days continuously to bring creatine under control but after discharging again in couple of days the creatine moved up because of the medication given..  very bad practice in deed to continue billing counter.. later we moved to Hyderabad kidney centre and their under supervision of Dr. Rajaram my father got treated properly, it's more than a year no more dialysis..
Thank you God, doctor and well wishers..
